title: Little A'Le'Inn: we made a digital copy

tellings.quote: she was like you think we're that stupid you don't think we would have made a digital copy

plain: A documentary filmmaker named James Fox says he went to the Little A'Le'Inn, a small diner and motel in Rachel, Nevada, asking about a VHS tape made by a man named Chuck Clark. According to Fox, the woman there scoffed and asked if he really thought they were stupid enough not to have made a digital copy. The story suggests the footage on that tape has been kept safe.
